title: An agent of any vendor looks facts up through AGENTS.md and the kb MCP server alone, with no Claude Code feature
goal: A generic MCP client that knows only AGENTS.md and the kb MCP server initializes at the current protocol version, lists the tools and gets a pack with a verdict, fact lines and url footer from kb_pack; nothing the lookup needs lives only in a Claude Code hook, skill or setting; plugin.md says how another vendor's agent registers the server; the check drives kb_mcp.py over stdio as such a client.

run: import json,subprocess as s,sys;m=[{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':0,'method':'initialize','params':{'protocolVersion':'2025-11-25','capabilities':{},'clientInfo':{'name':'generic-client','version':'1'}}},{'jsonrpc':'2.0','method':'notifications/initialized'},{'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'tools/call','params':{'name':'kb_pack','arguments':{'question':'Autopilot pre-provisioning requirements'}}}];p=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_mcp.py'],input=chr(10).join(json.dumps(x) for x in m)+chr(10),capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180,check=True);r=[json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.splitlines() if l.strip()];t=[c['text'] for x in r if x.get('id')==1 for c in x['result']['content']];print(t[0][:400] if t else r);sys.exit(0 if t and 'coverage:' in t[0] else 1)

notes: Premise did not reproduce at planning (SP-acysfnxr precheck, 2026-10-26): its check already passes, a generic MCP client that knows only the kb MCP server gets kb_pack's verdict, fact lines and footer today. What remains is plugin.md wording for registering the server in another vendor's agent; reshape to that, with a check that fails before it, before committing it to a sprint.
